title: Contract case
description: One case of the shared L2 corpus (contract/cases/): a public call and its inputs, how far it runs, and the reference's outcome. The Python runner (contract/runners/run_python.py) makes the public calls; the pure-Rust host (sdm-contract-run) starts the core operations under `core`. A case taken from the Phase 1b inventory keeps every key the inventory gave it.

status.description: acceptance: gating; diagnostic: run and reported, gating nothing (design, Merge rules).

paths.description: The scope-python.yaml paths this case covers.

routes.description: The paths python-core forces onto the core through SDM_CORE_ROUTES: every path the call may end on, since one call runs its paths on one route.

base.description: A base of contract/bases.yaml: DuckDB statements run on a fresh in-memory connection.

setup.description: DuckDB statements run after the base, on the same connection.

until.description: The last public call the case makes when nothing refuses: Schema.from_source, then PredictiveQuery.materialize, then SDMClient.predict.

core.description: The core operations the call starts, with the inputs the host passes them. The pure-Rust host starts these; python-core records what its host passed and the comparator holds the two equal.

schema.description: The contract's QuerySchema; the query text is input.pql.

from_source.description: Keyword arguments to Schema.from_source; absent means Schema.from_source(source).

materialize.description: Keyword arguments to materialize: anchor_time is an ISO timestamp; indices_as decimal makes each index Decimal(text).

expect.description: The reference's outcome: where the call ended, and for a refusal the exception's class name and StructuredDataError.code (null for one without a code). message and today are for information only.
